title.zh-CN: 咳嗽、茶色尿后胸痛和尿少 · 48岁男性
title.en: Cough and tea-coloured urine followed by chest pain and oliguria · 48-year-old male

summary.zh-CN: 围绕咳嗽、茶色尿后胸痛和尿少，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。
summary.en: Review the evidence, competing explanations and next steps for cough and tea-coloured urine followed by chest pain and oliguria.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别嗜酸细胞增多合并急进性肾炎。

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 比较血管炎与嗜酸细胞综合征。
识别肾脏与心脏急症的优先级。
说明病理未证实与残留肾损害。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain absent tissue proof and persistent renal impairment.

finding.en: Mild bilateral pitting oedema; no rash, reduced right basal breath sounds and no definite crackles.

name.zh-CN: 调阅嗜酸细胞和免疫检查

zh-CN: 调阅嗜酸细胞和免疫检查

text.zh-CN: 嗜酸细胞先为12.3×10^9/L，入院4.2×10^9/L；pANCA1:160，MPO-ANCA>200×10^3 RU/L，PR3-ANCA30×10^3 RU/L；抗GBM阴性。
text.en: Eosinophils were previously12.3×10^9/L and4.2×10^9/L at admission; pANCA1:160, MPO-ANCA>200×10^3 RU/L, PR3-ANCA30×10^3 RU/L; anti-GBM negative.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 肌钙蛋白I6.06 μg/L，V4–6 ST压低；CT双肺淡片影、胸腔积液；超声少量心包积液及左室顺应性下降。
text.en: TroponinI6.06 μg/L and V4–6 ST depression; CT patchy opacities and effusions; echo showed a small pericardial effusion and reduced LV compliance.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 粪便寄生虫阴性，骨髓嗜酸细胞增多，FIP1L1-PDGFRA阴性；肌电图未见明确神经源损害。未行肾活检，无冠脉造影资料。
text.en: Stool parasite testing negative, marrow eosinophilia and negative FIP1L1-PDGFRA; EMG showed no definite neurogenic injury. No renal biopsy or coronary angiography was supplied.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 血液滤过/透析及激素、环磷酰胺后嗜酸细胞下降、尿量恢复并脱离透析，心电及胸部影像改善。出院肌酐401 μmol/L，一年余随访244–273 μmol/L，ANCA阴性。
text.en: Haemofiltration/dialysis with glucocorticoids and cyclophosphamide was followed by lower eosinophils, recovery of urine output and dialysis independence, with ECG/chest improvement. Creatinine was401 μmol/L at discharge and244–273 μmol/L after over a year; ANCA became negative.

text.zh-CN: ANCA相关血管炎伴重度嗜酸细胞增多，原报告临床判断EGPA，组织机制未证实
text.en: ANCA-associated vasculitis with marked eosinophilia; the source clinically diagnosed EGPA without tissue proof

feedback.zh-CN: 鼻炎、嗜酸细胞、肾炎及心肺受累支持整合，但缺乏哮喘和病理需说明。
feedback.en: Rhinitis, eosinophilia, nephritis and cardiopulmonary disease support integration, while absent documented asthma and histology remain limitations.

text.zh-CN: 融合基因阴性完全排除所有HES
text.en: A negative fusion test excludes every HES

feedback.zh-CN: 该检测只排查部分分子亚型。
feedback.en: That test assesses only some molecular subtypes.

text.zh-CN: 肌电图阴性证明肾脏也未受累
text.en: Negative EMG proves no renal involvement

feedback.zh-CN: 肌电图不能推翻尿液和肌酐证据。
feedback.en: EMG does not negate urine and creatinine findings.

prompt.zh-CN: 什么处理优先级符合器官危险程度？
prompt.en: Which priority matches the organ-threatening severity?

text.zh-CN: 紧急肾脏支持并由风湿、肾脏和心脏团队评估诱导治疗与感染风险
text.en: Urgent renal support and rheumatology, nephrology and cardiology assessment of induction therapy and infection risk

feedback.zh-CN: 少尿、高钾和心肌损伤提示需同步支持与病因治疗。
feedback.en: Oliguria, hyperkalaemia and myocardial injury require support alongside disease-directed care.

text.zh-CN: 按轻型鼻炎等待门诊复查
text.en: Treat as mild rhinitis and wait for outpatient review

text.zh-CN: 只因没有哮喘而停下所有血管炎评估
text.en: Stop vasculitis assessment because asthma is absent

feedback.zh-CN: 表型不典型需要更谨慎鉴别，而非忽略器官急症。
feedback.en: An atypical phenotype warrants careful differentiation, not neglect of emergencies.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续肾功能改善允许作出什么结论？
prompt.en: What conclusion is permitted by later renal improvement?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。

text.en: Dialysis independence with residual renal impairment, without proof of crescentic histology or coronary arteritis

feedback.zh-CN: 长期肌酐仍升高，组织和血管证据缺失。
feedback.en: Creatinine remained elevated and tissue/vascular proof is absent.

text.zh-CN: 肌酐下降等于肾脏完全恢复

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告临床诊断重症EGPA伴急进性肾炎表型和心肌损伤；缺乏组织证实，随访仍残留肾损害。
conclusion.en: The source clinically diagnosed severe EGPA with rapidly progressive nephritis and myocardial injury; tissue proof was absent and renal impairment persisted.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 阴性单基因检测不能排除全部嗜酸细胞综合征。
keyReasoning.en: One negative molecular test does not exclude every eosinophilic syndrome.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 严重EGPA需器官支持与专科诱导治疗评估。
keyReasoning.en: Severe EGPA requires organ support and specialist induction assessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 临床诊断应与未证实的组织机制分开。
keyReasoning.en: Separate clinical diagnosis from unproven tissue mechanisms.
